chunks: And from him, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
A man complained to him that no children were being born for him. So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to him: 'When you have intercourse, then say:
O Allah, if You grant me a male, I shall name him Muhammad.'
He said: So he did that, and he was granted (a son).

key_terms.جَامَعَ: To engage in marital intercourse (euphemistic classical Arabic term for conjugal relations)
key_terms.ذَكَر: Male child; used here for a male offspring as opposed to a female
key_terms.رَزَقَ: To grant as a provision/blessing from God; used for both material and spiritual gifts

ai.seo_question: What supplication did Imam al-Sadiq recommend for those who wish for children?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribed a specific supplication to be recited at the time of intercourse for those who wish for offspring. The man was instructed to make a vow to name any son born to him 'Muhammad,' and when he did so he was granted a son. This hadith reflects the practice of seeking divine assistance through du'a and the meritorious status of the name Muhammad in Shia tradition.

en.hubeali: And from him, from one of our companions,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that a man complained to him<sup>asws</sup> that there were no children being born for him. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you copulate, so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If You<sup>azwj</sup> were to Grant me a male, I shall name him Muhammad’.
So he did that, and he was Granted (a son)’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from certain persons of our people who has said the following:
“Once, a man complained before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘The birth of a child does not take place for us.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘When going to bed with your wife say, ‘O Lord, if You grant me a son I will name him Muhammad.’
He (the narrator) has said that he followed the instruction, then a son was born to him.’”
